Lemma
[Ricci--DeTurck analytic dependence (Lemma 35.25)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0315 1. ch35:35.25\group Maximal Regularity

For the positive-metric neighborhoods $\mathcal G_\beta $ and $\mathcal G_\alpha $ defined from these spaces, $g\mapsto A(g)$ and $g\mapsto \widetilde{\mathcal A}(g)$ are analytic maps into $\mathcal L(\mathcal X_1,\mathcal X_0)$ and $\mathcal L(\mathcal E_1,\mathcal E_0)$, respectively.
